name: Hyderabad
title: Hyderabad: who is doing what about heat?
scope: Organisations and activities identified in public sources, read on 28 November 2026. It is not a complete list of everyone working on heat in Hyderabad, and no organisation was contacted.

orientation.text: Hyderabad tested cool roofs on 25 homes in 2017, and Telangana turned that into India's first state cool roof policy in 2023, with targets and a building permit rule. Each summer the state heatwave plan and the city corporation add water kiosks, health camps and warnings on junction screens, though the plan is advisory.

activities.evaluation: Indoor air on average 2°C cooler; 76% of residents in the trial group satisfied (NRDC's account).

activities.title: Telangana Cool Roofs Policy 2023-2028
activities.desc: State targets for cool roofs, a rule in building permits, mandatory coatings in government low-cost housing, and delivery to low-income homes through city heat plans.

activities.title: Telangana Heatwave Action Plan 2025
activities.desc: The state plan that sets what departments do once temperatures cross 40°C: treatment in health centres, changed work hours, free drinking water stands.

activities.title: Summer heat preparedness in the city (2026)
activities.desc: Drinking water kiosks, coordination with urban health centres and Basti Dawakhanas, medical camps at construction sites and heat warnings on junction screens.
